title: Read Smarter: Abstracts, Introductions and Main Ideas
objective: Students learn skimming, scanning, close reading, and identifying research purpose.
phrases: The purpose of this study was to ...
The authors wanted to find out whether ...
outcomes: Scan for names, numbers, methods, and results.
Identify main idea and research purpose.
Mark useful language in an abstract.
activity: Abstract detective: students underline background, purpose, method, result, and conclusion in a short abstract.
example: An abstract may say: “This study investigated whether salt stress reduces seed germination in rice.” That gives the purpose and variable.

classroom.title: Read a short bean plant study
classroom.description: Skim for the main idea, scan for numbers, and decide if a claim is supported.
